content:
liz_marketing: Quick thread to finalize a one-page battlecard and the webinar intro blurb. Focus: competitive positioning vs cloud AI platforms, API providers, and infra vendors. Angle: 'Serving-first economics' 6mdash; p95 predictability, transparent unit costs, and graceful fallbacks. Need: 1) SDR one-pager bullets, 2) 1-line bench blurb + test conditions for slide, 3) 3 procurement objection handlers. Deadline: EOD Fri. Who picks this up?

ana_sales: I can take SDR bullets and procurement handlers. Need bench numbers to make a short ROI example.

tom_research: Pasting sanitized bench highlights (internal only). These are from our March staging run; keep phrasing relative on public slides.

```text
Workload: multi-turn chat assistant, avg session ~350 tokens
Testbed: eu-west-1, A100-equivalent nodes, steady-state ~70% GPU util, 700 concurrent sessions
Redwood Inference (prod-opt): p50 38ms, p95 108ms, cost-per-convo $0.016
CloudManaged API: p50 82ms, p95 220ms, cost-per-convo $0.043
Self-host baseline: p50 30ms, p95 310ms (degrades under burst), cost-per-convo $0.028
```

liz_marketing: Thanks Tom. Public slide language: use relative phrasing like "~2x lower p95 vs CloudManaged in our tests" and include the testbed one-liner (region, node class, concurrency). Mark the slide "internal" until legal signs off.

ana_sales: Draft SDR one-pager hooks (short):
- Hook 1: "Worried about tail latency? Keep p95 predictable with tiered fallbacks."
- Hook 2: "Want to cut inference cost without sacrificing quality? Batching + KV-cache profiles reduce unit spend."
- Hook 3: "Need enterprise controls? Same API across hosted, dedicated, and private with KMS + audit logs."

ana_sales: Procurement rebuttals (one-liners):
- "We already run infra" -> "Our unified control plane + rollout tools reduce ops time and integrate with your infra; Dedicated pools let you keep control."
- "Data sensitivity" -> "Private/VPC deployments + KMS/HSM options and full audit logs; we adapt to on-prem requirements."
- "Pricing uncertainty" -> "Show me your volume and we'll model reserved vs on-demand savings; we expose per-conv economics so you can plan."

claire_content: I'll craft the hero sentence for the webinar landing and two A/B variants for the signup test. Candidate: "Predictable inference: lower p95, transparent unit costs, and automatic fallbacks that keep your app online." Short variant: "Serve LLMs predictably 6mdash; lower tail latency, clearer economics."

ryan_pm: Pick the short variant for ads, full for landing. Also, please add a 1-line methodology caveat to the slide: "Test conditions: eu-west-1; A100-class nodes; steady-state ~70% GPU util; synthetic session mix; quantized profile. Results vary by model and workload."

liz_marketing: Great. Tom, can you provide a tiny sanitized table we can paste on the slide (p50/p95/cost per convo) and a small chart image? Keep raw logs internal.

tom_research: I'll export a sanitized CSV and a simple bar chart (p95 only) with labels "Redwood" and "CloudManaged" circled. Will upload to internal assets.

deploy_bot: benchmark artifacts uploaded to internal storage (link redacted)

ana_sales: For the ROI example (prep for SDR slide): assume 1M convs/month. Quick calc: Redwood $0.016 -> $16k/mo; CloudManaged $0.043 -> $43k/mo. Delta: ~$27k/mo saved -> ~$324k/year. Use this as an illustrative example only.

claire_content: I'll write the slide blurb: "In our tests (eu-west-1, A100-class), Redwood delivered ~2x lower p95 vs CloudManaged and materially lower cost-per-conversation in the tested workload. Internal only." Add the test conditions line and the methodology caveat.

liz_marketing: Perfect. Owners and deadlines: Tom -> sanitized table + chart by Thu EOD; Claire -> hero variants + slide blurb by Thu 11am; Ana -> SDR one-pager + procurement lines by Thu 3pm. I'll assemble the battlecard and run a 10m dry-run Fri 9:50am PT.

ryan_pm: One more routing suggestion for webinar leads: include a poll on the registration form (pain: latency/cost/compliance). Route responses: latency/cost -> SDR; compliance -> solutions eng; SLA interest -> enterprise sales. Wire poll to registration payload.

liz_marketing: Add poll. Also tag all slide items as "internal" until legal review. Keep public-facing claims relative and defensible.

claire_content: Will mark internal and prepare a milder public copy that says "in our tests" and omits exact numbers if legal asks.

tom_research: Uploaded sanitized assets to the internal bucket; will PM the link.

liz_marketing: Thanks everyone. We'll reconvene 10min before the dry-run. If any blocker, post here.

(END)
